evals.prompt: Create a policy for GitLab merge requests and issues in this repo, learned from repo history.
evals.expected_output: Agent gates to GitLab-only, samples recent merged MRs/issues/commits via glab, synthesizes a project-level policy with MR/issue/linking/conventions sections, and writes/updates the policy marker block in tooling-appropriate locations (including .gitlab/content-policy.md). It then confirms which files were updated and summarizes the key extracted conventions.

evals.prompt: Generate a content policy for our Jira workflow (issues in Jira, MRs in GitLab). Use the Jira part as the source of truth.
evals.expected_output: Agent should not "widen" the skill into Jira-only management; it gates to GitLab-only content learning and asks which GitLab repo/MR/issue to learn from, or it limits output to GitLab-native policy content. No Jira-only policy should be produced.
